## Public-Safety Check

- [ ] No private person or staff data.
- [ ] No production IDs, internal URLs, database names, or raw logs.
- [ ] No secrets, tokens, signed URLs, or private repository links.
- [ ] No copied proprietary text or raw transcripts.
- [ ] Source, license, and redaction attestations are ready.
